claims.doc_section: 私有对象存储与永久删除
claims.conclusion: Map and World object images use separate private buckets and a shared MinIO connection/client implementation. Current production quotas are 8 GiB for Map Atlas and 24 GiB for World objects on a single minio-data named-volume disk, 32 GiB combined; there is no offsite image backup and PostgreSQL/restic backup is not image recovery. ADR-0014 treats the first-version backup gap as an accepted risk.
